The mechanism involves a cascade where Aetiocholanolone indirectly affects ATR by influencing the downstream signaling pathways of LXR. This relationship highlights a potential role for Aetiocholanolone in modulating kinase activity through its interaction with receptor proteins, offering a possible pathway for its biological effects.
